pages.text: You've got coins, haven't you? Everyone does, eventually. Glance at your &6purse&r on the screen. Coins come from selling goods, from quests and from what monsters leave behind.
Don't haul a fortune about. &6Cassius Vellum&r keeps the vault at the north end of the village. Dry fellow, but he's never lost a coin. Tell him I sent you.
